- Updated the pending notifications queue (queue/pending.json)

notification-system 1.0.0

- Initial release for centralized outbound notification management.
- Supports sending, scheduling, and tracking notifications across WhatsApp, Telegram, and Email channels.
- Includes built-in template management, message queueing, delivery logging, and rate limiting per channel.
- Features scheduling, priority handling, and opt-out support.
- Provides best practices for batching, fallback, deduplication, and personalization.
